data.one_liner: Changes and localizes your Flutter app launcher name on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A command-line tool which simplifies changing and localizing your Flutter app's launcher name on Android and iOS. It reads configuration defined in your pubspec.yaml file and applies the names across supported languages.
use_when: You need to change the displayed app name on your launcher.
You want to localize your app launcher name into multiple languages.
avoid_when: You do not use pubspec.yaml configuration files for project metadata.
You prefer modifying native project files manually.
strengths: Supports multiple languages using standard language tags.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic setup instructions.
Relies on manual command execution via terminal.
data.setup_notes: Add launcher_name configuration and dependency to your pubspec.yaml, then run flutter pub get and dart run launcher_name:main.
data.minimal_example:
launcher_name:
  default: "Default Launcher Name (English)"
  es: "Spanish Launcher Name"
  fr: "French Launcher Name"
